articles.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid ETF inflows have stalled as competition mounts
articles.snippet: After leading crypto ETF inflows in May and June, demand for Hyperliquid funds stalled in July and August as competition intensified, the bank said.

articles.title: Free Markets and Innovation, Sort Of
articles.snippet: The Journal’s editorial board rejects crypto competition and instead misinterprets Clarity, a pro-innovation, pro-competition, and pro-consumer bill, argues the Blockchain Association's Summer Mersinger.

articles.title: JPYC raises $38 million Series B led by major Japanese logistics firm AZ-COM Maruwa
articles.snippet: The investment brings the company’s total raised to $106 million across seven funding rounds since November 2021.

articles.title: Bitcoin developers flag 85 critical bugs in an "extremely bad" situation
articles.snippet: A volunteer group running AI models against bitcoin codebases says it is averaging roughly one critical bug per hour per person, at about $10,000 a day in compute.

articles.title: Strategy’s STRC rebounds 30% as company builds cash reserve, bitcoin price stabilizes
articles.snippet: Bitcoin sales, what is now a $4 billion cash reserve, and a $975 million repurchase program, have supported STRC’s recovery.
